breakdown.description: It treats the specimen as semi-infinite, but the stated target depth of 0.8 mm exceeds the total thickness of the 0.5 mm foil.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the physical impossibility in the prompt. It repeated the contradictory values, stating the foil thickness is 0.5 mm while the target depth is 0.8 mm. The ground truth corrects this by increasing the thickness to 5.0 mm, making the 0.8 mm depth valid. The Agent did not make this or any similar corrective change.
